description: Real LPA-approved scheme, Land south of the Meads, Priory Road, Milford Haven, SA73 2BS (25/0074/PA, reserved matters approval, decided 02/07/2026, under outline 12/0685/PA 2013). 89 dwellings total: 30 one-bedroom flats in 2-3 storey blocks (out of scope for v0, which only places houses/bungalows) plus 59 houses and bungalows. Mixed flats-and-houses scheme on a single spine road with two estate spurs and turning heads, access from Priory Road. Included as a density-rule test: the application site is 2.93ha and the approved scheme sits at 30.3 dwellings/hectare gross, right at Pembrokeshire LDP policy GN.26's stated minimum (30 dph in towns) for a site this size.
expectedUnitsMethod: LPA-approved split, read directly from the 25/0074/PA delegated decision report's own house-mix breakdown: 30 one-bedroom flats + 4 one-bed bungalows + 6 two-bed bungalows + 27 two-bed houses + 18 three-bed houses + 2 four-bed houses + 2 five-bed houses = 89 total (30 flats + 59 houses/bungalows). expectedUnits here is deliberately 59, NOT 89 — v0's engine only places houses/bungalows (no multi-storey flat blocks), so comparing its output to the full 89 would misreport a structural scope gap as an accuracy failure. See test-sites/README.md for the full method, the density-flag check this fixture exists for, and the boundary tracing method/error margin.
